author: Scrubz
quote: This game in no way shape or form deserves the critic reviews it has received. Reviews literally listing multiple major issues and saying the game is far from perfect yet still score it 100/100. Makes absolutely no sense. This game does nothing new its a culmination of used and tired ideas. The story PALES in comparison to the last 30 years of gta games.

author: Scrubz
quote: This game is perfect. Its a beautiful story, amazing art style and perfect music. What it really highlighted to me was something that is mostly missing from today's videogames. Its constant engaging fun that goes from one major story beat to another with no fluff and filler to arbitrarily extend the duration of the game. When I finished it I was happy and sad at the same time in that I wanted it to go longer but am glad it didn't as it was a complete package that from the word go was an absolute blast. Im not normally a massive nintendo guy as i dont really click with many of their games but i want to say thankyou nintendo for this game.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
